items.title: beyerdynamic launches AVENTHO Y ANC wireless headphones at IFA 2026
items.summary: beyerdynamic introduced the AVENTHO Y over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation, Bluetooth 6.0 multipoint, app-based sound personalization, replaceable components and over 90 hours of battery life, priced at US$149.99.

items.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 arrive with user-replaceable batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser's new flagship earbuds feature user-replaceable batteries, Bluetooth 6.0, upgraded ANC, Dolby Atmos head tracking and up to 40 hours of total battery life, priced at $299.

items.title: Anker Soundcore unveils THUS AI chip and enters OTC hearing-aid market
items.summary: At IFA 2026 Anker Soundcore debuted its proprietary THUS AI chip powering adaptive noise control across open-ear, over-ear and in-ear models, and announced a new OTC hearing-aid product based on the chip.

items.title: Plaud One Explorer Edition: TWS earbuds with a 4G LTE connected smart case
items.summary: Plaud unveiled true-wireless earbuds paired with a 4G LTE connected case that expands pickup range, positioning the product as a new human-AI interface for working professionals.

items.title: Timekettle W4 Plus AI interpreter earbuds expand real-time translation
items.summary: Timekettle's W4 Plus adds real-time translation across face-to-face talks, calls, meetings and media, with Babel OS 3.0, VoiceFocus noise reduction, 52 languages, 106 accents and AI meeting summaries.

items.title: Audio-Technica launches BP350ST mid-side stereo microphone in two variants
items.summary: Audio-Technica unveiled the BP350ST MS microphone in camera-mount (BP350ST-UL) and boundary/gooseneck (BP350ST-UB) versions for broadcast, ENG and field recording with independent line-cardioid and figure-of-eight capsules.

items.title: Sennheiser ships Spectera SKM handheld microphone on WMAS platform
items.summary: Sennheiser began shipping the Spectera SKM handheld microphone, completing its bidirectional broadband wireless ecosystem with Neumann capsules, ultra-low-latency audio, continuous monitoring and remote configuration.

items.title: Alliance for Open Media publishes Open Audio Renderer (OAR) v1
items.summary: AOMedia released OAR v1, a reference implementation for rendering spatial audio across playback environments, advancing open immersive-audio technology through its Audio Codec Working Group.

items.title: Audient introduces Horizon Thunderbolt audio interfaces for pro studios
items.summary: Audient announced the Horizon series (Horizon 8P, 16 and 32) of flagship Thunderbolt audio interfaces with 32-bit mastering-grade conversion, sub-millisecond round-trip latency and expandable architecture.

items.title: Sony expands ULT Power Sound party speakers with Tower Max, 7 and 5
items.summary: Sony Electronics announced three new ULT party speakers led by the massive ULT Tower Max, targeting bass-heavy live events and home entertainment with prices starting at $449.
